reviews.title: Immediate Ads
reviews.text: Within 3 minutes of opening the apps and creating my habit groups, I was given 2 ads that have a “timer” but once the time is up there is no way to exits the ad without clicking on it. This app was not created to help users but instead to make money point blank. Lame.
